Text: If you have <4 buildings in play, each turn, you may search your library for a building card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your library.

Name: Demalian Military Facility
Text: All units have +1 ATK as long as you have 6 or more units in play.

Name: Cobina Corp Starscale Research Facility
Text: If you have 8 or more items in play, draw an extra card during your draw step.

Name: Hideout of the Beast Tamers
Text: If you have 4 or more units in play AND all of your units in play have the #Beast tag, all your units get +1 ATK / +1 HP.

Name: Space Pirate Hideaway
Text: At the end of your turn, if an opponents' unit was destroyed this turn, return a chosen ability-interrupt card from your graveyard to your hand.
